headline: Azerbaijan discusses next steps for developing the banking sector - PHOTO
summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan met bank managers to discuss new priorities and risks in the banking sector. The meeting was held with members of the expanded presidium of the Association of Banks.
why: Regulatory priorities for banks shape lending conditions and financial stability in Azerbaijan's economy.
